gen-almendra-display-gf-heebo: Almendra Display has ornate, literary letters that never seem to pinch shut, with a pronounced x-height. Heebo follows in a plain sans, its tall central band and curves that stop short keeping long paragraphs tidy.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-lexend-peta: Red Hat Display draws its line like a marker, with visible daylight inside every curve. Lexend Peta brings a big x-height and curves that never thin, which is what makes the pair feel so confident.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-lexend-zetta: Marker-like lines of constant width give Red Hat Display its bold, contemporary stamp. Lexend Zetta, widely tracked and tall in the body, would carry a long stretch of text like cut ribbon unrolling.
gen-almendra-display-gf-hind-madurai: Almendra Display is ornate and literary, its letters refusing to pinch shut. And Hind Madurai answers with sans strokes cut from one ribbon, so the decorative top and the flat, wide-open text below don't compete.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-cascadia-mono: Punchy and marker-drawn, with daylight in every curve. Cascadia Mono counters by standing compact, its letters like pins in a wide board, while Red Hat Display is the one that grabs attention.
gen-almendra-display-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru presses its lowercase tops close to the ascender height, with no calligraphic thinning anywhere in the plain sans. Almendra Display's ornate, literary shapes make it the pair's strongest quality.
gen-almendra-display-gf-hind-siliguri: Hind Siliguri hums along in a flat gray of constant line weight, its rounds gapped like a cracked bangle in a plain sans. Almendra Display adds the ornate, literary spark above it.
gen-almendra-display-gf-huninn: Ornate meets modern here. Huninn keeps its stroke widths steady from stem to curve, which lets Almendra Display's literary, never-pinched letters take the spotlight above it.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-work-sans: Work Sans reads contemporary and open, its c tips never creeping toward touching and its mean line set high. And over a long stretch, those joins as thick as the strokes keep the text steady for the eye.
gen-almendra-display-gf-inter-tight: Inter Tight reads modern and compact, with short ascenders and curve tails held well back from the body. But Almendra Display handles ornate, literary flourish best, while the sans simply carries the text.
